title: Mekashu and Dida claim Ethiopian double in Guadalajara (short item inside the Castellon 10km report)

story.W: Kolole Mekashu and Mercy Jerop Kwambai broke away with Anahi Alvarez. Mekashu and Kwambai waited to kick and ran together briefly before Mekashu moved ahead and won by four seconds.
story.M: A large pack reached 10 km in 30:36 and a break of six passed 15 km in 45:17, leaving Dida, Lasoi, Kibet and Kilimo for the finish. Gemechu Dida had the strongest sprint and held off Isaia Kipkoech Lasoi, both given 1:03:38.

performances.name: Kolole MEKASHU
performances.note: Won in a personal best of 1:12:49 with a late move.

performances.name: Mercy Jerop KWAMBAI
performances.note: Second in 1:12:53, beaten in the final kick after running with Mekashu.

performances.name: Anahi ALVAREZ
performances.note: Third in 1:12:54. Her move in the breakaway set the pace and she gained on Kwambai but ran out of road.

performances.name: Gemechu DIDA
performances.note: Won in 1:03:38 with the strongest finish.

performances.name: Isaia Kipkoech LASOI
performances.note: Second in the same time of 1:03:38 after running with Dida in the pack; held off in the sprint.

performances.name: Moses KIBET
performances.note: Third in 1:03:43, five seconds behind the winners.

performances.name: Rhonzas Lokitam KILIMO
performances.note: Fourth in 1:03:46, one of the final four in contention.
